title: McGee Creek RV Park

services.name: Rv Sites
services.desc: Deposits will be received at the time of booking. Balance paid in full at check-in, prior to occupying your site. Stay between April 20 and May 21, 2026, and save 27% when you book 3 weeks (21 nights)! Enjoy a Premium Full Hook-Up Site--water, electric, sewer, and 50 Amp service--for just $1,000 plus 15% tax, a $365 savings! (Applies to sites 33, 34, 35, and 36.) These sites are located right along McGee Creek, each uniquely landscaped and featuring its own picnic table. The sites offer full hook-ups, including sewer, water, and 30-amp power. For an additional $10 per day, 50-amp power is available. Most of these are back-in sites, with one pull-thru option. Tent camping is allowed on these

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Our tent sites are spread throughout McGee Creek RV Park, offering a range of scenic options. Some sites are located along McGee Creek or near the U-Ketch-Em trout ponds, while others are spacious grassy areas in different parts of the park. These sites are ideal for tent campers. Each site comes with its own picnic table, and all guests have access to hot showers, clean restrooms, and a dishwashing

services.name: Creekside Cabin
services.desc: Relax in our beautifully appointed Creekside Cabin, offering stunning views and a spacious outdoor area. The large deck features patio furniture with an umbrella, a BBQ propane grill, and a picnic table on a grassy lawn. Inside, the cabin comfortably sleeps six, with one queen bed on the main floor and two queen beds in the loft. services.name: Catch-and-Keep Fishing
services.desc: Marking the start of trout fishing season, the Eastern Sierra Fishing Opener, also known as "Fishmas," is a much-anticipated event. Anglers from around the region flock to Mammoth Lakes for a chance to catch trophy-sized trout in the area's pristine lakes

blurb: Hello and welcome! At McGee Creek RV Park, we offer creekside RV sites, tent sites, a private cabin, and stocked fishing ponds just 10 miles south of Mammoth Lakes, CA. Nestled at the base of the Sierra Nevada Mountains, we overlook Long Valley and Crowley Lake, with views of the Glass Mountains and White Mountains in the distance.
